claim_boundary: Public evidence registry for Recursive Settlement. Reference/evaluator evidence, synthetic frontier evidence, production conformance, and independent validation remain distinct.

records.title: Phase V comparator baseline
records.summary: 35/35 comparator matches across seven scored semantic axes.
records.limitations: Internal/reference comparator evidence only; not production conformance or independent external validation.

records.title: CR-Core reference closure execution
records.summary: 4,760 pair interaction cases, 9,520 checked pair obligations, 5 recursive chains, 8/8 mutants detected, 0 survivors, 0 unexplained minimized failures.
records.limitations: Repository-local reference/evaluator closure only; production target undeclared.

records.title: CR-Core reference/evaluator freeze readiness
records.summary: From this point forward, closure is measured by how many minimized failures cannot be explained by the existing V001-V035 semantic basis, not by raw generated test count.
records.limitations: This report is a readiness gate for the Phase V/VI closure campaign. It supports freezing the repository-local CR-Core reference/evaluator semantics within the declared scope. It does not claim production-kernel conformance, external independent validation, universal completeness, or formal irreducibility.

records.title: CR Frontier Adversarial Evaluation Pack v0.1
records.summary: Synthetic offline frontier pack: 10/10 reference scenarios passed and 14/14 expected mutant exploits detected.
records.limitations: Not production KORE, not GMAP deployment, not production conformance, not external validation.

records.title: Production KORE conformance
records.summary: Production conformance requires a declared production target, exact artifact identity, and unchanged-corpus execution against that target.
records.limitations: Do not infer production conformance from reference/evaluator evidence.

records.title: External independent reproduction
records.summary: No external institution/reviewer reproduction is claimed in this registry.
records.limitations: Internal differential agreement and local reproduction are not external independent validation.

records.title: VALIS Coq proof snapshot
records.summary: Machine-checkable Coq source snapshot for the historical/formal kernel lineage is included with manifest and digests. This supports bounded formal evidence and does not establish production KORE conformance or current CR-Core implementation correspondence.
